claude_proposed_widenings.name: Attachment { kind: "object" }
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Light targets a physical object, not a creature or area. The Attachment union in types.ts has no 'object' variant. v4 §3 lists 'object' in attachment atoms, but it is not exposed in the surface schema. Adding this variant is a surface_widening prerequisite.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: You touch one Large or smaller object that isn't being worn or carried by someone else.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: grant_illumination
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Light's sole mechanical operation is causing an object to shed Bright Light (20 ft radius) and Dim Light (additional 20 ft). No existing OngoingOperation variant (roll_modifier, damage_on_hit) captures illumination. No v4 effect atom models light emission as a deterministic mechanical property granted to an object. A new atom — grant_illumination or emit_light — is required.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: Until the spell ends, the object sheds Bright Light in a 20-foot radius and Dim Light for an additional 20 feet.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: Duration { kind: "timed", selfBreak: true }
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The spell ends when cast again ('The spell ends if you cast it again'). The Duration type has no self_break field or trigger. v4 has a 'self_break' lifecycle atom but it is not surfaced in types.ts. This is a secondary gap — the timed duration itself fits; only the early-termination trigger is missing.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: The spell ends if you cast it again.
